summary_en: This study tests sapanisertib and serabelisib (PIKTOR), given with fulvestrant and/or other anticancer therapies, in people with HR+/HER2- advanced or metastatic breast cancer. Serabelisib and sapanisertib are taken by mouth, and fulvestrant is given as an injection into the muscle; how often and for how long are not stated. The study evaluates safety and preliminary effectiveness, and it is a Phase 1/2 dose-escalation trial.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa sapanisertib y serabelisib (PIKTOR), administrados con fulvestrant y/u otras terapias contra el cáncer, en personas con cáncer de mama HR+/HER2- avanzado o metastásico. Serabelisib y sapanisertib se toman por vía oral, y fulvestrant se administra como inyección en el músculo; la frecuencia y la duración no se indican. El estudio evalúa la seguridad y la eficacia preliminar, y es un ensayo de escalada de dosis de Fase 1/2.
who_for: Advanced or recurrent disease that cannot be cured with surgery or radiation.
Received at least one prior systemic therapy.
At least one measurable or evaluable lesion under RECIST v1.1.
ECOG performance status of 1 or less at screening.
not_for: Brain or central nervous system metastases, unless treated and off steroids for at least 4 weeks.
Prior PI3K, AKT, mTORC1/2, or dual PI3K/mTOR inhibitor.
Other active malignancy within the past 24 months, with some exceptions.
Concurrent participation in another therapeutic clinical trial.
